framework.objective: Rescue the reviewer REJECT only by specifying one minimal audited pilot-row route, not by expanding the protocol.
framework.claim_boundary: This file claims only that a concrete pilot-row route can be attempted and audited. It does not claim that R_oe exists, that C_phi is independent, or that any current public literature already contains a passing row.
framework.canonical_P_oe: P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even) / (chi_odd + chi_even), with denominator-floor censoring only.

pilot_row_route.material_and_specimen: La3Ni2O7 bilayer nickelate crystals or lamellae cut from one documented boule/growth lot, with adjacent pieces assigned before output labels are visible.

measurements: orientation and phase check by laboratory XRD or synchrotron micro-XRD before pressure loading
Raman or equivalent low-damage structural/quality check before and after high-dose spectroscopy
normal-state pressure-path ledger in one pressure cell: pressure medium, marker series, load branch, dwell, thermal-cycle count, gradient estimate, gasket/culet/cell identity
odd/even contrast-sensitive normal-state spectroscopy for chi_odd and chi_even on the frozen q, omega, qz, polarization, temperature, and pressure grid
non-superconducting output-free normal-state transport or optical c-axis proxy only if acquired before superconducting label reveal
same_sample_piece.P_oe_source: P_oe is extracted only from the frozen odd/even susceptibility spectra and their calibration files for PILOT-001-A.
B_min_same_sample_fields: normal-state c-axis proxy if independently acquired outside the P_oe fitting state

sibling_pieces.relationship: nearest-neighbor cut from same boule and same anneal/storage history as PILOT-001-A
measurements: oxygen stoichiometry or oxygen-vacancy/layer-asymmetry proxy by EELS, STEM-EELS, XAS, SIMS, TGA/coulometry, or an equivalent calibrated route
Ni valence, ligand-hole, or orbital proxy by XAS/XES/EELS or equivalent
sibling_pieces.why_sibling: These probes may be destructive or dose-heavy, so they are sistered rather than forced onto the P_oe carrier.
sibling_pieces.pre_output_tolerance: Green only if oxygen/layer-asymmetry and phase class remain within frozen repeatability/mismatch limits before any superconducting output reveal.

sibling_pieces.relationship: optional second adjacent sibling from the same cut sequence
measurements: normal-state optical/transport/structural anisotropy used as ordinary c-axis baseline if PILOT-001-A cannot provide a clean independent c-axis proxy
sibling_pieces.why_sibling: Used only to keep B_min independent from the qz/matrix-element nuisance state used in P_oe extraction.
sibling_pieces.pre_output_tolerance: Green only if c-axis proxy, phase, and quality remain within frozen sibling tolerances; otherwise the row is yellow or red.

facility_probe_route.P_oe_probe: A synchrotron RIXS or equivalent odd/even bilayer susceptibility probe capable of preserving raw detector frames/spectra, standards, geometry, polarization/qz metadata, and refittable calibration code.
facility_probe_route.B_min_probe_set: Independent structural, oxygen/valence/orbital, disorder, normal-state c-axis, and pressure-ledger probes from lab XRD/synchrotron XRD, Raman, XAS/EELS/STEM-EELS/SIMS/TGA/coulometry, optical conductivity or normal-state transport, and pressure-cell metrology.
facility_probe_route.near_future_acceptance_condition: The route is acceptable only if the facilities agree before acquisition to blinded row IDs, immutable raw archive deposit, independent P_oe and B_min extraction workspaces, and a packet-lock hash before output reveal.

required_artifacts: raw RIXS or equivalent detector frames/spectra for chi_odd and chi_even
calibration standards, blanks/darks/backgrounds, resolution files, elastic-line references, geometry/polarization/qz metadata, and channel-mixing covariance inputs
raw XRD/Raman/pressure-marker files for same-sample structural, quality, damage, and pressure-path fields
raw sibling oxygen/valence/orbital files and mapping metadata
raw normal-state c-axis proxy files when used
exact extraction code, environment lockfile, config files, and checksum manifest
immutable_raw_archive.archive_form: Facility repository, institutional data repository, materials-data repository, or read-only object store with DOI/handle/immutable URI plus SHA256 manifest. Embargo is allowed, but write-once timestamp and independent auditor access must exist before output reveal.
minimum_passing_evidence: archive URI or repository accession exists
every raw file needed to regenerate P_oe, B_min, censor flags, and U_miss is listed
auditor can verify that archive timestamp predates superconducting-output reveal

roles.sample_custodian: assigns opaque specimen IDs and maintains genealogy/cut/transfer ledger
roles.P_oe_extractor: receives only blinded spectroscopy archive and calibration files
roles.B_min_extractor: receives only blinded baseline archive and sibling-tolerance ledger, not P_oe spectra or P_oe nuisance parameters
roles.firewall_auditor: classifies green/yellow/red from locked P_oe, B_min, censoring, and U_miss without output labels
roles.output_custodian: holds superconducting labels and releases them only after packet lock

custody_log: growth lot, cut order, anneal/storage, piece dimensions, orientation, and visible defects
date/time/person for each transfer and measurement
pressure-cell load/unload history and thermal cycles
file creation timestamps and archive deposit timestamps
custody.independence_rule: B_min must be regenerable with P_oe spectra, odd/even fit parameters, and superconducting labels hidden. P_oe must be regenerable with B_min fields and superconducting labels hidden.

pre_measurement_lock: row_id, sibling_set_id, batch/growth lot, cut-order relationship
which measurements are same-sample and which are sibling
q, omega, qz, polarization, temperature, and pressure grid for P_oe
denominator floor epsilon_D derivation from susceptibility-channel calibration only
sibling mismatch tolerances for oxygen/layer asymmetry, phase fraction, pressure path, damage, c-axis proxy, and sample quality
B_min variable list and allowed instruments
post_archive_pre_reveal_lock: P_oe value or censor flag with extraction hash

output_reveal.allowed_time: Only after packet-lock hash is written and witnessed by the firewall auditor.
revealed_fields: superconducting gap or related output fields if measured
output_reveal.hard_rule: No row inclusion, censoring, U_miss, B_min, P_oe extraction, pressure landmark, or sibling-tolerance decision may change after reveal.

green: same-sample P_oe archive is complete and refittable
canonical P_oe is valid or explicitly uncensored by the frozen epsilon_D rule
B_min table can be regenerated without P_oe spectra, P_oe nuisance terms, or superconducting labels
sibling B_min fields pass pre-output tolerance limits
pressure path and damage ledger are complete
output custodian confirms no superconducting output reached extractors or auditor before lock
yellow: one non-core sibling baseline is proxy-only but U_miss was frozen before reveal
archive is complete but one repeat calibration is missing
ordinary c-axis proxy comes from a sibling rather than the same sample but remains within frozen tolerance
red: raw archive or checksum manifest is missing
P_oe denominator floor is tuned with B_min or output information
B_min uses the same qz/matrix-element fitted nuisance state that defines P_oe
sibling mismatch exceeds frozen red tolerance on oxygen, phase, pressure path, c-axis state, or damage
any output label influences sample choice, grid, thresholds, row inclusion, censoring, B_min, U_miss, or firewall classification before packet lock
firewall_test.pilot_pass_condition: The salvage row passes only if PILOT-001 is green before output reveal. Yellow is rehearsal only and does not rescue reviewer REJECT.

feasibility_verdict.reason: A minimal real route is physically concrete: same-sample odd/even susceptibility and pressure/structure ledger on PILOT-001-A, destructive oxygen/valence/orbital baselines on formally sistered adjacent pieces, independent extraction, immutable raw archive, frozen censoring/U_miss, and sealed output reveal. This is enough to define the exact row the reviewer asked for.
feasibility_verdict.current_status: No passing audited pilot row is claimed from the files read. The route becomes a reviewer-facing salvage only after the archive URI, custody log, extraction hashes, packet-lock hash, and pre-reveal green firewall classification actually exist.
feasibility_verdict.minimum_next_artifact: A one-row pilot dossier containing the archive accession/URI, SHA256 manifest, custody ledger, locked P_oe extraction, locked B_min extraction, frozen U_miss/censoring table, firewall classification, and output-custodian attestation.

triggers: no facility will provide immutable raw archive and calibration deposit before output reveal
P_oe and B_min cannot be extracted by independent teams with the other side's nuisance terms hidden
destructive B_min probes cannot be tied to same-sample or formally sistered pieces by pre-output tolerances
superconducting labels are already known to the extractors or influence any pre-reveal decision
canonical P_oe censoring or U_miss cannot be frozen before reveal
the row is yellow or red rather than green before reveal
failure_if_unavailable.admission: If these conditions cannot be met for even PILOT-001, LP28-CphiPacket remains rejected protocol packaging and should not be described as packet-feasible.

allowed: A single concrete pilot-row route has been specified.
The route separates same-sample P_oe spectroscopy from sibling-only destructive B_min fields where necessary.
The route requires immutable raw archive, custody ledger, independent extraction, frozen censoring/U_miss, sealed output labels, and pre-reveal firewall classification.
The route is only conditionally salvageable until a real archive and custody package exist.
forbidden: The reviewer REJECT is overturned by protocol text alone.
A yellow rehearsal row is enough to claim salvage.
Current literature already contains a passing audited PILOT-001 row.

inspector_check.remaining_weakness: This is a route, not a completed audited row. The reviewer can still reject unless PILOT-001 is actually executed or an existing facility dossier can be produced with the stated archive and firewall evidence.
